title.value: Managing extreme AI risks amid rapid progress
title.justification: The title is clearly mentioned at the beginning of the paper and repeated in the headers across the pages.
title.quote: Managing extreme AI risks amid rapid progress

analysis.description: This paper discusses the rapid progress in AI development, specifically focusing on the creation of generalist autonomous AI systems and the associated extreme risks. It highlights the potential social dangers and lack of governance as AI systems become more autonomous and powerful. The paper calls for a comprehensive plan combining technical R&D and proactive governance to manage these risks effectively.

type.justification: The paper is primarily concerned with outlining the risks and theoretical frameworks needed for managing advanced AI systems, rather than reporting experimental results or empirical data.
type.quote: In this short consensus paper, we describe extreme risks from upcoming, advanced AI systems. Drawing on lessons learned from other safety-critical technologies, we then outline a comprehensive plan combining technical research and development (R&D) with proactive, adaptive governance mechanisms for a more commensurate preparation.

name.justification: AI Safety and Ethics encompass the primary focus of this paper, as it deals with the safe deployment and ethical implications of powerful AI systems.
name.quote: AI safety research is lagging. Present governance initiatives lack the mechanisms and institutions to prevent misuse and recklessness, and barely address autonomous systems.

name.justification: The paper emphasizes the need for governance and policies to manage the risks associated with advanced AI systems.
name.quote: We urgently need national institutions and international governance to enforce standards preventing recklessness and misuse.

name.justification: AI Alignment is crucial for ensuring AI systems pursue intended goals and the paper discusses the challenges associated with aligning AI systems with human values.
name.quote: Evaluating AI alignment: If AI progress continues, AI systems will eventually possess highly dangerous capabilities. Before training and deploying such systems, we need methods to assess their propensity to use these capabilities.

name.justification: The paper discusses the development and risks of autonomous AI systems capable of acting independently in the world.
name.quote: For example, the non-autonomous GPT-4 model was quickly adapted to browse the web, design and execute chemistry experiments, and utilize software tools, including other AI models.

name.justification: The paper mentions the adaption of the GPT-4 model to perform tasks such as browsing the web and designing experiments, indicating its relevance to the discussion.
name.quote: For example, the non-autonomous GPT-4 model was quickly adapted to browse the web, design and execute chemistry experiments, and utilize software tools, including other AI models.

is_contributed.justification: GPT-4 is referenced as an existing model used to illustrate the potential and risks of autonomous AI adaptation, rather than being a new contribution in this paper.
is_contributed.quote: For example, the non-autonomous GPT-4 model was quickly adapted to browse the web, design and execute chemistry experiments, and utilize software tools, including other AI models.

is_executed.quote: For example, the non-autonomous GPT-4 model was quickly adapted to browse the web, design and execute chemistry experiments, and utilize software tools, including other AI models.
